description: Link settings, transceiver DOM, FEC, pause, IEEE counters, and NIC ring/channel tuning.

panels.title: Link settings
panels.description: From ETHTOOL_GLINK / GLINKSETTINGS, LINKMODES_GET, GPAUSEPARAM, and GEEE.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_link_up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_link_speed_mbps{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device, duplex, port) (ethtool_link_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_link_autoneg{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_linkmode_lanes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_pause_setting{setting="rx", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_pause_setting{setting="tx", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_eee_info{setting="active", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
ethtool_link_up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}

panels.title: Link-down events
panels.description: Extended link-down counter from ETHTOOL_MSG_LINKSTATE_GET (kernel 6.6+ and driver support).

targets.expr: increase(ethtool_linkstate_down_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0

panels.title: Transceivers
panels.description: Module EEPROM identity and digital optical monitoring (cached per --collector.optics.cache). Thresholds are generic; check the datasheet.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, device, vendor, part_number, serial) (ethtool_module_dom_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_module_temperature_celsius{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_module_voltage_volts{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_module_bias_milliamps{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_module_tx_power_dbm{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
max by (job, instance, device) (ethtool_module_rx_power_dbm{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"})
ethtool_module_rx_power_dbm{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}
ethtool_module_tx_power_dbm{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}
ethtool_module_temperature_celsius{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}
ethtool_module_bias_milliamps{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}
ethtool_module_voltage_volts{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}
ethtool_module_channel{metric="rx_power_dBm", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}
ethtool_module_channel{metric="tx_power_dBm", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}

panels.title: FEC corrected blocks
panels.description: Corrected FEC blocks are normal at low rates; a rising trend often precedes uncorrectable errors.

targets.expr: rate(ethtool_fec_blocks_total{stat="corrected_blocks", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])
rate(ethtool_fec_blocks_total{stat="uncorrectable_blocks", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0

panels.title: Pause frames
panels.description: Flow-control frames. Sustained RX pause means the peer is congested; TX pause means this host is.

targets.expr: rate(ethtool_pause_frames_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0

panels.title: IEEE 802.3 / RMON errors
panels.description: Standardized counters from ETHTOOL_MSG_STATS_GET (eth-phy, eth-mac, rmon groups).

targets.expr: rate(ethtool_std_statistics{stat=~"FrameCheckSequenceErrors|AlignmentErrors|FrameTooLongErrors|InRangeLengthErrors|OutOfRangeLengthField|FramesLostDueToIntMACRcvError|FramesLostDueToIntMACXmitError|SymbolErrorDuringCarrier|etherStatsUndersizePkts|etherStatsOversizePkts|etherStatsFragments|etherStatsJabbers", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0
sum by (direction, low, high) (rate(ethtool_rmon_hist_packets{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Driver statistics (ethtool -S)
panels.description: Driver-specific ETHTOOL_GSTATS counters filtered by the "Driver stat" variable. Names vary by driver.

targets.expr: rate(ethtool_nic_statistics{stat=~"$nic_stat", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0

panels.title: Ring buffers
panels.description: ETHTOOL_GRINGPARAM. rx_pending well below rx_max_pending is a common cause of rx_missed_errors.

targets.expr: max by (iface, setting) (label_join(ethtool_ring_setting{setting=~"rx_pending|rx_max_pending|tx_pending|tx_max_pending", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}, "iface", " ", "instance", "device"))

max by (iface, setting) (label_join(ethtool_channel_setting{setting=~"combined_count|max_combined|rx_count|max_rx|tx_count|max_tx", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}, "iface", " ", "instance", "device"))

max by (iface, setting) (label_join(ethtool_coalesce_setting{setting=~"rx_usecs|tx_usecs|rx_max_frames|tx_max_frames|use_adaptive_rx|use_adaptive_tx", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", device=~"$device"}, "iface", " ", "instance", "device"))
